text:
tara: quick sync — i'm opening a small set of docs PRs to tidy naming, tone, and a couple of broken anchors. short reviews only, please. :wave:

ben: which files?

tara: PRs: 
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5301 (sdk-snippets-consistency)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5302 (migration-guide-clarify)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5303 (glossary-cache-entries)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5304 (embeddings-anchor-fix)

zoe: quick question: do we change canonical API names?

tara: no. canonical API remains snake_case. examples should be idiomatic per language. we'll add an explicit note in the style guide explaining this mapping.

ben: ok. for snippets CI, can we run a lightweight smoke runner for JS + Python?

tara: yes — add examples/ci-smoke.{js,py} and a docs-ci job that runs both with a fake key. keep it under 30s.

zoe: glossary phrasing? i've seen both "KV cache" and "key-value cache" in docs.

tara: prefer "key-value (KV) cache" on first mention, then "KV cache" after. add cross-refs to runtime caching and prefix caching.

infra-bot: reminder: docs site deploys after PR merge; small builds ~3-4m.

ben: for migration guide, let's include a tiny mapping table showing API -> idiomatic examples, e.g., `prompt_text -> promptText` for JS.

zoe: i'll own 5303 and add the cross-refs.

tara: great. docs-bot: require 1 docs + 1 eng approval for PRs touching SDK snippets.

docs-bot: rule set applied.

tara: timeline: docs approvals today, eng approvals by tomorrow 10am PT. i'll post a short merge order after CI green.

ben: will review 5301 tonight.

zoe: will land 5303 after a quick lint pass.

tara: thanks team — short checklist here: 
- [ ] style guide note about canonical vs idiomatic param names
- [ ] snippet smoke tests in docs CI
- [ ] glossary first-mention phrasing + cross-refs
- [ ] anchors + redirects for embeddings guide

ben: 👍

zoe: all set, starting now.
